sections.title: Live Classes
sections.description: Real-time interactive sessions with the teacher where students ask questions, practice speaking, and get immediate feedback. Not pre-recorded - every class is live. Structured self-study materials provided by the teacher - worksheets, vocabulary lists, grammar exercises, and practice activities tailored to each level.

sections.title: Self-Study at Home
sections.description: Students reinforce learning through assigned homework, audio practice, reading materials, and online exercises between live classes.

sections.title: Practice & Revision
sections.description: Regular revision sessions, mock tests, speaking practice groups, and personalized feedback to consolidate learning and track progress.

sections.title: Exam Preparation
sections.description: Focused training for Goethe, DELF/DALF, HSK, and IELTS exams - past papers, exam strategies, timing practice, and examiner insights.
